hypotheses.title: Dual Relationship Synergy with 5-Day Weekly Delta Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Refines Candidate 1 by extending the short-term reversion window from 3 days to 5 days (1 trading week). Weekly price reversal reduces daily noise and suppresses portfolio turnover from 31% to under 20%, pushing Sharpe past 1.25 and Fitness past 1.00.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 5-day delta fails to lower turnover or degrades sub-universe Sharpe below 0.53.
